newsitem.title: USA: Edison San Onofre 3 nuke resumes full power.
newsitem.headline: Edison San Onofre 3 nuke resumes full power.

text.p: Edison International's 1,080 megawatt (MW) San Onofre 3 nuclear power unit, which had been reduced to 90 percent for about 30 hours this past weekend, has resumed full power output, the company said Monday.
The unit, near San Clemente, Calif., was operating at reduced power so that operators could clean out condenser tubes, a company spokesman said.
The adjacent unit 2, with a generating capacity of 1,070 MW, has been shut for maintenance and refueling since November 30.
The unit was scheduled to restart around February 8, but the company said that this may be delayed by approximately two weeks for additional maintenance.
"Once we complete the inspection work, we'll have a better idea as to when we can restart," the spokesman said.
The units are operated and majority-owned by Edison International's Southern California Edison Co.
